worldcombat.skill.recycle.summary: Reforge a held item you used up in battle: gather the fragments of the remembered item back into your hands so it can be used again. It comes to nothing while your hands are full or when there is nothing to recycle.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.use.0: Regrow a berry eaten during the fight
worldcombat.skill.recycle.use.1: Reforge a held item that was knocked away
worldcombat.skill.recycle.use.2: Put an item back in your hands after it runs out
worldcombat.skill.recycle.description.0: Gather fragments and matching dropped items within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.description.1: Bend down to gather for %1$s, %2$s to gather yourself after the item forms, and a %3$s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.description.2: The memory comes from battle: the item is recorded the moment your hands go from full to empty and cleared once recycled; one item per use.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.scavenge.on: Scavenge: recovery radius x1.8, and it first sweeps matching dropped items off the ground and pulls one in as material (that drop disappears), at the cost of a x1.25 wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.scavenge.off: Recycle from memory: it restores only the remembered item, with a shorter wind-up (x0.85) and without touching anything in the world.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.timing: Self-cast; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to recycle, then %3$s seconds to gather yourself and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.growth.0: At level %1$s the recovery radius rises to %2$s blocks and the cooldown becomes %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.growth.1: At level %1$s the recovery radius rises to %2$s blocks and the sparks rise to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.recycle.preference.sca: On: recovery radius x1.8 and it pulls a matching dropped item in as material (that drop disappears), but the wind-up is x1.25. Off: recycle purely from memory, x0.85 wind-up, leaving the world alone.
